title: Is Slickorps Trade a good broker for someone just starting with CFDs?
author: Beautyify_72
selftext:
I'm still pretty new to trading and have been trying to learn about different brokers before opening an account. I recently found them and saw that they offer CFD trading and mention using blockchain technology on their platform.

Has anyone here actually used them? Are they beginner friendly, and how was your experience with deposits, withdrawals, and placing trades? Is this a reasonable broker to start with, or would you recommend looking elsewhere first?   
  
I don't want to rush into signing up without hearing from people who have real experience.
